tagline: A Few Who Builds What's Next

flagshipProgram.title: She Builds
flagshipProgram.eligibility: Exclusively for girls — open to all idea creators in Week 1
flagshipProgram.ownershipPolicy: Shared between the idea creator and Grevix under clearly defined terms, with proper credit for everyone involved.

roadmap.name: Explore
roadmap.week1: Complete creative freedom to explore ideas and decide what to build and how to approach it. Top 2 most promising ideas are selected at the end of Week 1.
roadmap.weeks2to4: Refine concepts, validate system architecture, and plan the engineering approach.

roadmap.name: Build & Grevix Innovation Lab
roadmap.summary: Build teams, start active development, and unlock the Grevix Innovation Lab (mentorship, collaboration with industry professionals and engineers, and opportunities to connect with companies).

roadmap.name: Improve, Test & Showcase
roadmap.summary: Focus on improving, rigorous testing, and showcasing completed projects to partner companies and the community.
